failureDescription: A valid teacher/source package or meeting post is treated as proof that a receiving Mother acknowledged, implemented, gate-ran, adopted, or obtained user acceptance for the method.
rejectedArtifact: Teacher-only package, old receiver checkpoint, or receiver output without an exact Task Anchor, fresh receiver delta, exact-commit run, and Delivery Receipt.
mustNeverRepeat: Do not convert POSTED into ACKNOWLEDGED without an actual receiver receipt.
Do not convert teacher-side GATE-RUN into receiver-side GATE-RUN.
Do not copy source-domain numeric thresholds or object identities into another domain without receiver evidence.
Do not use an old receiver checkpoint as proof of post-dispatch implementation.
Do not call a method ADOPTED or USER-ACCEPTED from producer self-review.
requiredEvidence: Receiver-specific unique taskId, targetObject, targetDefectOrChange, accepted baseline and baseSha.
Exact source method package identity and receiver-declared UNKNOWN fields.
Fresh receiver head delta created after dispatch and bound to the exact commit.
Negative invariant showing the forbidden target behavior is absent.
Positive liveness oracle showing the required adjacent behavior still occurs.
Two paired mutation probes: forbidden behavior re-enabled and adjacent behavior disabled.
Receiver Delivery Receipt with machine/reference gates and current desktop plus 390x844 browser evidence for visual changes.
Explicit lifecycle receipts kept separate for POSTED, ACKNOWLEDGED, IMPLEMENTED, GATE-RUN, ADOPTED and USER-ACCEPTED.
gateLogic: FAIL if any receiver lifecycle state above POSTED is claimed without a receiver-authored or independently verified receipt.
FAIL if a receiver artifact predates the dispatch or does not bind to its reported head.
FAIL if only the negative invariant is tested and adjacent required behavior is not proven live.
FAIL if source-domain constants are copied without a receiver-specific baseline and reference rationale.
HOLD if targetObject, targetDefectOrChange, accepted baseline, baseSha or referenceSet remains UNKNOWN.
appliesTo: Any method, observation practice, material rule, clothing rule, geometry rule, animation rule, validation strategy or production protocol transferred between Mothers.
Current R355 behavior-exclusion dual-oracle teaching package transfer to Motor Mother and Train Mother.
